text.p: A continued firmness of asking rates for raw cotton has been evident in most European markets, traders said.
Some additional interest has been noted in purchasing Central Asian styles, particularly better qualities. Premiums asked for better grades from most origins have tended to increase.
Most buyers and sellers now await a fresh indication of the price direction in New York following the extended Thanksgiving holiday.
Traders said fine spinners in several markets have in the meantime continued to purchase modest additional qualities of American Pima and selected Egyptian styles.
